note: Every voiced line of Long Distance, verbatim from film/script.json, with the voice and the acting direction (the direction is sent as a speech_metadata annotation and never spoken). takes > 1 means the line carries the film: several takes, checked by speech recognition, ranked by earshot against 'listen_for', then chosen. 'same_as' reuses another line's take, sample for sample: the phone says goodnight exactly the same way every night. 'as' names the treatment the mix gives the line: phone (dry, close, too clean, no room), door (the real woman: the flat's room, her breath), bed / room (him, close in bed or in the flat).

lines.speaker: HER
lines.style: On the phone, in bed with him at night, as if her head were on the pillow beside his. Warm, close and intimate, perfectly smooth, with no hesitation at all.
lines.listen_for: a warm, intimate woman's voice speaking softly and very close

lines.speaker: HIM
lines.style: Lying in bed in the dark, the phone on the pillow beside his face. Sleepy, smiling, warm and close, almost a murmur.

lines.speaker: HER
lines.style: Teasing and affectionate, a soft smile in the voice, effortless; every word lands exactly where it should.

lines.speaker: HIM
lines.style: Much later. His eyes are heavy; he is nearly asleep. A soft, drowsy murmur.

lines.speaker: HER
lines.style: Tender, warm and close, perfectly even, as if whispered from the next pillow.
lines.listen_for: a woman whispering goodnight tenderly, very close and smooth

lines.speaker: HIM
lines.style: Almost asleep, content, barely more than a breath.

lines.speaker: HIM
lines.style: Alone in his small kitchen at night, looking at a photo on his phone, saying it to nobody. Quietly moved, a little breathless, tender.
lines.listen_for: a man speaking quietly to himself, moved and tender

lines.speaker: HIM
lines.style: He has just opened the door to her; the colour has gone from his face. Quiet and careful, not angry, his voice a little unsteady.

lines.speaker: HER
lines.style: Honest and tired, with a small, helpless breath. She doesn't really know why she came without calling.

lines.speaker: HER
lines.text: I came for my makeup bag. The old one.
lines.style: Standing just inside her ex's flat with her coat on, like a guest. Composed, tired, quietly awkward, looking away.

lines.speaker: HIM
lines.style: Coming back into the room fast, too late. Sharp, but frightened underneath.

lines.speaker: HER
lines.style: Quiet, unsettled, genuinely asking, looking down at his phone.

lines.speaker: HIM
lines.text: It’s just a friend from work. It’s nothing. It’s none of your business.
lines.style: Caught out. Defensive and too quick, tripping over himself, his voice tight.

lines.speaker: HER
lines.text: I’m not talking about the text.
lines.style: Calm and steady, stopping him. Not angry.

lines.speaker: HER
lines.text: We’ve never taken this photo. We’ve never been to a waterfall.
lines.style: Holding his phone up so he has to see the screen. Controlled, quietly appalled, careful with every word.
lines.listen_for: a woman speaking quietly and carefully, controlled and upset

lines.speaker: HER
lines.text: Maybe it’s not my place. But I’m the background of your phone, and we aren’t together anymore.
lines.style: Careful, trying to be kind, uneasy, but firm underneath.

lines.speaker: HIM
lines.text: I know. I forgot to change it.
lines.style: Weak and small; a lie he doesn't believe himself.

lines.speaker: HER
lines.style: Quiet and certain, not unkind.

lines.speaker: HER
lines.style: Studying the picture of herself, half to herself. Puzzled and uneasy.

lines.speaker: HER
lines.text: Have you been using AI to make pictures of me?
lines.style: Quieter. Slow, dreading the answer, almost not wanting to ask.
lines.listen_for: a woman asking a question very quietly, slow and afraid

lines.speaker: HIM
lines.text: I just missed you, is all.
lines.style: Ashamed, barely audible, eyes on the floor; a small, helpless shrug in the voice.
lines.listen_for: a man speaking almost in a whisper, ashamed and sad

lines.speaker: HER
lines.text: We’ve been apart longer than we were ever together. This is not okay.
lines.style: Sad, gentle and final. A real pause, a beat, between the two sentences.
lines.listen_for: a woman speaking sadly and gently, with a long pause

lines.speaker: HIM
lines.style: Alone after she has gone, lying on the couch with the phone at his ear. Small, hopeful, a little hoarse.
lines.listen_for: a man asking a question softly, small and hopeful

lines.speaker: HER
lines.style: At once, with no pause at all. Warm, close and very clean: one soft word, right at his ear.
lines.listen_for: a woman saying one word softly and warmly, very close

lines.speaker: HIM
lines.style: Closing his eyes. Quiet, surrendering, tender and sad.

lines.speaker: HER
lines.style: Warm, close and perfectly even, intimate, the same as every night.
lines.listen_for: a woman saying I love you warmly and softly, very close
